color-surface-spotlight.$description: High-emphasis surface for diagram source nodes — inverse-dark in light mode, teal-dark in dark mode so it never inverts to a light blob

color-text-frozen-primary.$description: Text on fixed brand-color backgrounds (case heroes) — references the warm primitive directly so it never inverts in dark mode

color-text-frozen-secondary.$description: Muted text on fixed brand-color backgrounds (case heroes) — never inverts in dark mode

color-accent-glow.$description: Teal glow behind diagram source nodes — alpha strengthens in dark mode where the glow does more of the lifting
